_note: SURVEY, a new type, written 2026-10-12 on his "First we need 01a and 02a. It's bugging me we start from 03",
and his pick of the survey verb the same hour. 01a was held for type 8 (two planets); his call was to fill 01a
and 02a with types that build today, so type 8 moves to 10a when its remote second place exists.
Shape: three sensors read in ANY ORDER behind one counted objective (07a's group), then one send at the
team's beacon. The house shape: an unfinished job somebody else started. No combat.
Each sensor sets its own stage in whatever order, so no journal line says first, next or last.
Ends on a single beat, so the beacon's journal is stage 100's line and no recap is written.
MODELS NOT ON THE APPROVED LIST (docs/quests/objects.md), his eye first: SeismicSensor01.nif is vanilla's
own quest sensor (Quest_SeismicSensor01, SFBGS001_Quest_MultifunctionSensor01); Satellite_Beacon.nif is
vanilla's Satellite_Beacon static. Neither seen in a Delve yet.

place._theme: Keeps the base's own exclusions (no natural sites, no caves). A ground survey before somebody builds reads right at a worked site.

prose.name: Survey: Seismic Sensors on <Planet>
prose.briefing: A survey team set three seismic sensors at the <Place> and left before anyone came back to read them. Nobody builds on that ground until someone does.

beats.objective: Read the seismic sensors at the <Place>
beats.journal: This sensor had been knocked off true. I set it level again and pulled its readings.
beats.name: Tilted Seismic Sensor

beats.journal: Dust had drifted over this sensor up to the lid. I dug it out and the readings were still there.
beats.name: Half-Buried Seismic Sensor

beats.journal: This sensor was still logging on its own, weeks after the team left. I copied everything it had.
beats.name: Logging Seismic Sensor

beats.objective: Send the readings from the survey beacon
beats.journal: The survey team's sensors at the <Place> had been sitting unread. I collected all three sets of readings and sent them from the team's beacon.
beats.name: Survey Uplink Beacon
say: That's all three. Data's coming through.
Huh. The ground's been busier than we thought.

broadcast: A survey team set three seismic sensors down there, then left before anyone came back to read them.
Nobody's building on that ground until we've seen those readings.
